summary: Quantum eMotion Corp filed a 6-K disclosing a September 28, 2026 Arrangement Agreement to acquire Plurilock Security Inc, with the Canadian plan-of-arrangement serving as the US equivalent of a merger agreement. Quantum acts as parent/acquirer; Plurilock is the target. Locked-up voting and support agreements cover Ali Hakimzadeh, Blake Corbet, Ian Patterson, Jen Swindell, Veera Singh, Planet Ventures and Game 7, though no stake percentage, price per share or premium is stated in the excerpt. Mechanics involve interim and final court orders, a shareholder meeting, bridge financing, and TSX-V delisting. Watch votes, financing and regulatory timing.
